dev_hub.title: Developers
dev_hub.write_warning: These tools write directly to items and related tables, bypassing the normal adapter/dispatcher pipeline. There's no undo beyond what's in the audit log below each item, and no confirmation beyond the browser's own dialog on Delete.
dev_hub.add_item_desc: Hand-create an item row with any field values.
dev_hub.sql_runner_desc: Ad hoc, read-only SELECT queries against the live database.
dev_item_form.write_warning: This writes directly to items, bypassing the normal adapter pipeline. Every save/create here is its own audit_log event (actor ui.dev).
dev_item_form.reset_dispatch_help: Clears this item's in-flight/tracked delivery state for the given consumer without re-arming it — different from Rearm on the item's own page, which schedules an immediate redelivery. Use this to clear stuck or incorrect state while debugging.
dev_sql.title: SQL runner
dev_sql.readonly_warning: Read-only — this connects to the database in SQLite's own read-only mode, so even a query that somehow slipped past validation can't write anything. Only a single SELECT (or WITH ... SELECT) statement is accepted. Results are capped at {row_limit} rows.
dev_sql.truncated_note: Showing the first {row_limit} rows — narrow your query (add a WHERE/LIMIT) to see a different slice.
